header: Somebody who knows your plant before you ring
author: Ingrid Halmweger
role: Head of service, Vienna and Lower Austria
text: Ingrid has been putting together maintenance schedules here since 2011 and looks after the housing associations herself. She is the one to ask what an existing contract actually covers.
note: Reachable Monday to Thursday 07:30 to 16:30 and Friday until 12:30. Outside those hours the breakdown line on 0800 24 24 90 is the right number.
